name: Curly Fries
steps: Use a spiral cutter to cut scrubbed potatoes into long curls. Rinse and soak in cold water for 20 minutes to remove loose starch.
Drain and dry completely. Toss gently with rice flour so every curl gets a light dusting without breaking.
Heat oil to 175°C. Fry small loose batches for 4–5 minutes, separating curls with a slotted spoon, until uniformly golden and crisp.
Drain on a rack; mix paprika and salt and dust over the hot fries. Serve at once.
tips: Do not crowd the pan or the coils clump and steam instead of crisping.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
